sqlMap.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.USER_ID, O.STATUS, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDERED_AT, U.USERNAME FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN USERS U ON O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #orderId#

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.USER_ID, O.STATUS, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDERED_AT, U.USERNAME FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN USERS U ON O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
O.USER_ID = #userId#
O.STATUS = #status#
O.TOTAL_AMOUNT >= #minAmount#
O.ORDERED_AT >= #orderedAfter#
ORDER BY O.ORDERED_AT DESC
SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STATUS, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #userId# ORDER BY ORDER_ID DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.STATUS, COUNT(OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE) AS COMPUTED_TOTAL FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #userId# GROUP BY O.ORDER_ID, O.STATUS HAVING COUNT(OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID) > 0
SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STATUS, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #userId# UNION SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STATUS, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ARCHIVED_ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #userId#
SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STATUS, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE TOTAL_AMOUNT > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_AMOUNT) FROM ORDERS)

SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STATUS, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE 1 = 1
